notes: Uniarch is the budget sub-brand of Uniview (UNV) and shares the same /media/videoN RTSP path convention. Streams are 1-indexed: video1=main, video2=sub, video3=third. The lead /media/video2 in the StrixCamDB input happens to match the official sub-stream path. Port 554 is the default; credentials prepended as rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}/media/video<N>.
